question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Lucky**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 

 
• **Lucky **is the most appropriate option to fill in the given blank.
 
• **Lucky **means having good luck or being fortunate. (सौभाग्यशाली होना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She was lucky to find a parking spot right in front of the store.*
